general.description: An old outpost converted to border station, R'itll has been extended over time with multiple modules, giving it a ragtag look. This is quite deceptive, as the station is k'rinned by some of the best squadrons of the Council Fleet. A few merchants hail from the station, mainly trading in raw minerals.
general.bar: A small complement of pilots and a crowd of merchants, mainly regular K'Rinns and Rithai
